title: ApplicationExecutionContext
description: Concrete invocation-local context owned by Relay. Application-defined payloads belong under data, leaving the top level for built-in Relay fields. Structural validity does not establish authorization.

data.description: Optional application-owned JSON object. Middleware defines its schema, meaning and trust policy. Omission and an explicitly empty object are distinct. Relay does not interpret application keys or treat them as authorization.
